candidates.title: OpenAI Solves 80-Year-Old Math Mystery with AI
candidates.description: OpenAI announced that an internal reasoning model autonomously disproved the Erdős Unit Distance Conjecture, a problem in discrete geometry that has stumped mathematicians since 1946. The 125-page proof was hailed by Fields Medalist Tim Gowers as a 'milestone in AI mathematics.'
candidates.significance: High, demonstrates advanced AI reasoning capabilities, potentially revolutionizing scientific discovery and mathematical proofs.

candidates.title: Trump Scraps AI Safety Executive Order
candidates.description: President Trump cancelled a planned executive order that would have established a 90-day safety review framework for frontier AI models. The decision reportedly followed direct calls from industry leaders like Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, and David Sacks, who argued the regulations would hinder the U.S. lead over China.
candidates.significance: High, a major reversal in US AI policy, moving away from immediate federal safety regulation for frontier models, with long-term implications for AI development and governance.

candidates.title: Anthropic's Claude Mythos Uncovers 10,000 Software Vulnerabilities
candidates.description: Anthropic disclosed that its latest model, Claude Mythos, identified over 10,000 high-severity flaws in 'systemically important' software through its defensive 'Project Glasswing.' The model's extreme capabilities have sparked a geopolitical debate over the safety of releasing such powerful cybersecurity tools.
candidates.significance: High, showcases extreme AI capabilities in cybersecurity, raising major safety and geopolitical concerns regarding powerful AI models and national security.

candidates.title: Anthropic Reaches Profitability, OpenAI Prepares for IPO
candidates.description: Anthropic projected $10.9 billion in Q2 2026 revenue, marking its first-ever quarterly operating profit and is reportedly raising funds at a $900 billion valuation. Meanwhile, OpenAI is preparing a confidential S-1 filing, targeting a September 2026 listing at a valuation between $852 billion and $1 trillion.
candidates.significance: High, these financial milestones and anticipated IPOs signify the maturation and massive scaling of the AI industry, profoundly shaping its future structure and investment landscape.

candidates.title: Google Unveils 'Agentic' Search Powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash
candidates.description: Google unveiled a major redesign of Search powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash, introducing 'information agents' that can autonomously track topics (like apartment hunting) and perform tasks like booking appointments.
candidates.significance: High, a fundamental change to how users interact with search and information, potentially redefining the role and capabilities of search engines and personal assistants.
